capabilities: Send task reminders through ntfy and other channels
Schedule notifications in advance so they arrive while Obsidian is closed
Automatically complete recurring tasks through the Tasks plugin
Filter tasks by files, folders, tags, and quiet hours
Diagnose why a task received no notification with Why not
extras: Free and open-source with optional donations; interface translations are distributed as separate JSON files outside the plugin. The ntfy server limits how far ahead messages can be scheduled, and non-ntfy channels require Obsidian to be running.
intentEvidence: the modification diverged significantly from the original
motivation: The author used Ntfy Notifications by Murat, was missing a feature and added it himself, then kept developing independently with priorities of Tasks integration, ntfy, task automation, and mobile resource efficiency.
problem: Obsidian cannot send task reminders on its own, and reminders stop when the app is closed; recurring tasks also have to be completed manually each time.

relations.evidence: This is an independent project developed and maintained by Alekcei-BAV, based on Murat's original work.
installing and enabling Tasks is recommended

summary: Task reminder plugin that sends scheduled notifications via ntfy and other channels and auto-completes recurring tasks through the Tasks plugin.
